#version 330 core
// Generated by vmath ShaderHeader from the Java struct layouts. Do not edit.
#ifndef VMATH_LINES
#define VMATH_LINES

// std430, 48 bytes, alignment 16: p0@0, along0@12, p1@16, along1@28, prev@32, flagsAndStyle@44
struct LineSegment {
    vec3 p0;
    float along0;
    vec3 p1;
    float along1;
    vec3 prev;
    uint flagsAndStyle;
};

// std430, 64 bytes, alignment 16: color@0, dash0@16, dash1@32, width@48, miterLimit@52, flags@56, dashCount@60
struct LineStyle {
    vec4 color;
    vec4 dash0;
    vec4 dash1;
    float width;
    float miterLimit;
    uint flags;
    uint dashCount;
};

const int VERTS_PER_SEGMENT = 54;
const int ROUND_STEPS = 8;

layout(location = 0) in vec3 segments_p0;
layout(location = 1) in float segments_along0;
layout(location = 2) in vec3 segments_p1;
layout(location = 3) in float segments_along1;
layout(location = 4) in vec3 segments_prev;
layout(location = 5) in uint segments_flagsAndStyle;

// the attributes hold the instance that is being drawn: the argument is not used
LineSegment fetch_segments(int i) {
    LineSegment r;
    r.p0 = segments_p0;
    r.along0 = segments_along0;
    r.p1 = segments_p1;
    r.along1 = segments_along1;
    r.prev = segments_prev;
    r.flagsAndStyle = segments_flagsAndStyle;
    return r;
}

uniform usamplerBuffer styles_texels;

LineStyle fetch_styles(int i) {
    uvec4 t0 = texelFetch(styles_texels, i * 4);
    uvec4 t1 = texelFetch(styles_texels, i * 4 + 1);
    uvec4 t2 = texelFetch(styles_texels, i * 4 + 2);
    uvec4 t3 = texelFetch(styles_texels, i * 4 + 3);
    LineStyle r;
    r.color = vec4(uintBitsToFloat(t0.x), uintBitsToFloat(t0.y), uintBitsToFloat(t0.z), uintBitsToFloat(t0.w));
    r.dash0 = vec4(uintBitsToFloat(t1.x), uintBitsToFloat(t1.y), uintBitsToFloat(t1.z), uintBitsToFloat(t1.w));
    r.dash1 = vec4(uintBitsToFloat(t2.x), uintBitsToFloat(t2.y), uintBitsToFloat(t2.z), uintBitsToFloat(t2.w));
    r.width = uintBitsToFloat(t3.x);
    r.miterLimit = uintBitsToFloat(t3.y);
    r.flags = t3.z;
    r.dashCount = t3.w;
    return r;
}

#endif // VMATH_LINES

uniform mat4 u_viewProjection;
uniform vec2 u_viewport;
uniform float u_worldToPixel;

out vec4 v_color;
out float v_along;
flat out vec4 v_dash0;
flat out vec4 v_dash1;
flat out uint v_dashCount;

const float EPS = 1e-6;
const float STRAIGHT = 1e-4;
const float PI = 3.14159265358979;

vec2 rot(vec2 v, float a) {
    float c = cos(a);
    float s = sin(a);
    return vec2(v.x * c - v.y * s, v.x * s + v.y * c);
}

vec2 screenOf(vec4 c) {
    return (c.xy / c.w * 0.5 + 0.5) * u_viewport;
}

// the vertex vid of a segment on the screen, in pixels: the same arithmetic as LineGeometry.vertex
vec2 lineVertex(int vid, vec2 s0, vec2 s1, vec2 sp, int flags, float h, int cap, int join, float miterLimit, float along0, float along1, out float along) {
    vec2 d = s1 - s0;
    float len = length(d);
    along = along0;
    if (!(len > EPS)) {
        return s0;
    }
    vec2 t = d / len;
    vec2 n = vec2(-t.y, t.x);
    if (vid < 6) {
        bool atEnd = vid == 2 || vid == 4 || vid == 5;
        float side = (vid == 0 || vid == 2 || vid == 5) ? 1.0 : -1.0;
        along = atEnd ? along1 : along0;
        return (atEnd ? s1 : s0) + side * n * h;
    }
    int local = vid - 6;
    bool endPiece = local >= 3 * ROUND_STEPS;
    if (endPiece) {
        local -= 3 * ROUND_STEPS;
    }
    int tri = local / 3;
    int corner = local - tri * 3;
    vec2 c = endPiece ? s1 : s0;
    along = endPiece ? along1 : along0;
    int kind = 0;
    vec2 o1 = vec2(0.0);
    vec2 dir = vec2(0.0);
    float phi = 0.0;
    float scale = 1.0;
    if (!endPiece && (flags & 1) != 0) {
        vec2 q = s0 - sp;
        float plen = length(q);
        if (plen > EPS) {
            vec2 tp = q / plen;
            float cr = tp.x * t.y - tp.y * t.x;
            float dt = dot(tp, t);
            float outer = cr > 0.0 ? -1.0 : 1.0;
            o1 = outer * h * vec2(-tp.y, tp.x);
            vec2 o2 = outer * h * n;
            phi = atan(o1.x * o2.y - o1.y * o2.x, o1.x * o2.x + o1.y * o2.y);
            if (abs(cr) < EPS && dt < 0.0) {
                phi = (-o1.y * tp.x + o1.x * tp.y) > 0.0 ? PI : -PI;
            }
            if (abs(phi) > STRAIGHT) {
                if (join == 2) {
                    kind = 1;
                } else if (join == 0) {
                    float cosHalf = cos(phi * 0.5);
                    if (cosHalf > STRAIGHT && 1.0 / cosHalf <= miterLimit) {
                        kind = 3;
                        scale = 1.0 / cosHalf;
                    } else {
                        kind = 2;
                    }
                } else {
                    kind = 2;
                }
            }
        }
    } else if (!endPiece && (flags & 2) != 0 && cap != 0) {
        o1 = n * h;
        dir = -t;
        kind = cap == 2 ? 1 : 4;
        phi = PI;
    } else if (endPiece && (flags & 4) != 0 && cap != 0) {
        o1 = -n * h;
        dir = t;
        kind = cap == 2 ? 1 : 4;
        phi = PI;
    }
    int steps = kind == 1 ? ROUND_STEPS : (kind == 2 ? 1 : (kind == 3 ? 2 : (kind == 4 ? 3 : 0)));
    if (tri >= steps || corner == 0) {
        return c;
    }
    int k = tri + (corner == 2 ? 1 : 0);
    vec2 v;
    if (kind == 1) {
        v = rot(o1, phi * float(k) / float(ROUND_STEPS));
    } else if (kind == 2) {
        v = rot(o1, phi * float(k));
    } else if (kind == 3) {
        v = rot(o1, phi * float(k) * 0.5) * (k == 1 ? scale : 1.0);
    } else {
        float sgn = k <= 1 ? 1.0 : -1.0;
        float push = (k == 1 || k == 2) ? h : 0.0;
        v = sgn * o1 + dir * push;
    }
    return c + v;
}

void main() {
    LineSegment seg = fetch_segments(0);
    LineStyle st = fetch_styles(int(seg.flagsAndStyle & 0xFFFFFFu));
    int vid = gl_VertexID % VERTS_PER_SEGMENT;
    int flags = int(seg.flagsAndStyle >> 24u);
    vec4 c0 = u_viewProjection * vec4(seg.p0, 1.0);
    vec4 c1 = u_viewProjection * vec4(seg.p1, 1.0);
    vec4 cp = u_viewProjection * vec4(seg.prev, 1.0);
    if (!(c0.w > 0.0) || !(c1.w > 0.0)) {
        gl_Position = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 2.0, 1.0);
        v_color = vec4(0.0);
        v_along = 0.0;
        v_dash0 = vec4(0.0);
        v_dash1 = vec4(0.0);
        v_dashCount = 0u;
        return;
    }
    if ((flags & 1) != 0 && !(cp.w > 0.0)) {
        flags &= ~1;
    }
    float widthPx = ((st.flags >> 4u) & 1u) == 1u ? st.width * u_worldToPixel / c0.w : st.width;
    float along;
    vec2 pos = lineVertex(vid, screenOf(c0), screenOf(c1), screenOf(cp), flags, 0.5 * widthPx, int(st.flags & 3u), int((st.flags >> 2u) & 3u), st.miterLimit,
            seg.along0, seg.along1, along);
    bool atEnd = vid >= 6 + 3 * ROUND_STEPS || vid == 2 || vid == 4 || vid == 5;
    float z = atEnd ? c1.z / c1.w : c0.z / c0.w;
    gl_Position = vec4(pos / u_viewport * 2.0 - 1.0, z, 1.0);
    v_color = st.color;
    v_along = along;
    v_dash0 = st.dash0;
    v_dash1 = st.dash1;
    v_dashCount = st.dashCount;
}
